entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac... I hope you can help. I bought a ProFit Jersey a little while ago, and... well, I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the wrong size. I guess I was a bit optimistic. It's just way too tight across the chest, and I can't comfortably ride in it. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for this specific jersey. It's just been sitting in its box, making me sad. I really needed this money back for bills.
I completely understand how frustrating it is when something doesn't fit as expected, especially when you've been looking forward to it. Let me just pull up your order details... one moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered about 55 days ago. I have some good news for you.
Oh? I was so worried I had waited too long.

Not at all. Your ProFit Jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy. You're well within the timeframe, so I can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you. We could also start an exchange for the correct size if you'd prefer.
You can? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so stressed about this. Given everything, I think I'd just prefer the refund for now.

Of course. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just repackage the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've really helped me out. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
